question.question: Do two enemy players each having two warriors trigger Martial Law when spreading sympathy, and does Martial Law increase Organize cost?

expected.expected_answer: No: requires at least three warriors of one other player, not combined enemies. Organize costs removal of own warrior, no supporters and no Martial Law surcharge.

source_passages.section: Woodland Alliance (8); Spread Sympathy and Martial Law
source_passages.quotation: - **Spread Sympathy:** Choose unsympathetic clearing adjacent by path to sympathy; if no sympathy anywhere, choose any clearing. Spend matching supporters shown above next sympathy token. **Martial Law:** add one matching supporter if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of **one other player**. Place token and score uncovered space. Only one sympathy per clearing. Keep's placement ban still applies.

Organize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost; it still needs legal token placement. **After operations**, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.

answer.part: Martial Law with two players' warriors
answer.ruling: No. Martial Law requires at least three warriors belonging to one other player in the chosen clearing. Two warriors from each of two enemy players do not meet that single-player threshold.

answer.ruling: Martial Law does not increase Organize's cost. Organize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost, though sympathy placement must be legal.
